task.description:
Draft two new frontend requirements for subdomain-based tenant routing: OIDC-F-05 (backend tenant-config discovery endpoint) and OIDC-F-06 (frontend dynamic OIDC config from hostname). Add them to docs/BPM_Platform_Frontend_Requirements.md as a new Stage F1.6 section after Stage F1.5. See task details below.

OIDC-F-05 (MUST): Backend endpoint GET /api/tenant-config?host={hostname} returns { oidc_authority: string, client_id: string } for the tenant bound to that hostname. If no binding found, returns the default tenant config. Requires a new hostname column (or separate table) linking tenant to hostname. Existing OIDC-12 realm-tenant binding provides the oidc_authority.

OIDC-F-06 (MUST): Frontend reads window.location.hostname on app startup before rendering LoginPage, calls GET /api/tenant-config?host={hostname}, and uses the returned oidc_authority and client_id to initialize OidcManager dynamically. VITE_OIDC_AUTHORITY and VITE_OIDC_CLIENT_ID env vars remain as compile-time fallbacks. The call must be made once and cached (e.g. in a Zustand store or module-level singleton). If the API call fails, fall back to the env var values.
acceptance_criteria: OIDC-F-05 and OIDC-F-06 appear in docs/BPM_Platform_Frontend_Requirements.md under Stage F1.6
Each requirement has: description, priority (MUST), acceptance criteria, and See references
OIDC-F-05 references OIDC-12 (realm-tenant binding) and ADP-03 (tenant context)
OIDC-F-06 references OIDC-F-01 (SSO button) and OIDC-F-05 (discovery endpoint)

result.summary: Drafted Stage F1.6 requirements OIDC-F-05 and OIDC-F-06 in docs/BPM_Platform_Frontend_Requirements.md
